// diagnostic

E0405

`??` fallback type/`return` mismatch

What

`??` fallback type/`return` mismatch

Why

The `??` fallback stands in for the missing value, so it must have the same type, or leave the function

Fix

Make the fallback type match the return type and fallible value.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0405: tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.stderr.

Error [jet.FailureDomainNotErrorType]: Explicit failure domain `String (text)` is not an Error type
  --> tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.jet:1:20
    |
  1 | parse_age: fn() -> Int String! { return .Ok(42) }
    |                    ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `!` contract may name `Err`, a Core error, a type marked `#Error`, an all-error union, or `Never`; arbitrary value types do not describe failures.
 Fix: Use a Core error, add `#Error` to a local error type, or remove the explicit error contract.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2417

Error [jet.FallbackTypeMismatch]: `??` must diverge after a refutable binding
  --> tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.jet:3:40
    |
  3 | run: fn() { parse_age() == .Ok(age) ?? 0 }
    |                                        ^
 Why: A failed pattern match cannot continue without defining the captures
 Fix: Use `return`, `panic(...)`, `break`, or `next` as the fallback
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0405
